entries.headline: Built a read-only unified Gmail inbox
entries.summary: Implemented the initial J-Mail application with Google OAuth using the Gmail read-only scope, multi-account inbox aggregation, incremental synchronization, sanitized message viewing, attachment downloads, search, and encrypted refresh-token storage.

entries.headline: Added AI inbox triage and semantic Q&A
entries.summary: Added on-sync email classification and flags with TypeSafe, then implemented an Ask panel using locally generated embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking, Claude tool calls, and citations to matching emails.

entries.headline: Implemented session-only thought development for Margin
entries.summary: Implemented the local writing-coach workflow for temporary thought-development sessions, including structured coaching contracts, session notes, contextual entry, temporary article state, copy/discard behavior, and validation tests.
